name: EVA-Bench
description: Future exploration EVA operations, especially Mars surface EVAs and some higher-tempo Artemis scenarios, will require greater crew autonomy than the International Space Station paradigm because of communication latency, limited bandwidth, and increased operational complexity. Although large language models (LLMs) and agentic AI systems show promise as onboard decision-support tools, their suitability for safety-critical EVA operations remains unclear due to the lack of domain-specific evaluation frameworks.
